title: Q4 Scenario 4: Noisy / Ambiguous Call — Nudges Should Be Suppressed
description: Call with ambiguous, fragmented, and noisy customer utterances that should NOT trigger nudges. Tests false-positive suppression. Customer gives one-word answers, static, and filler words but no clear signals.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Hello! Thank you for calling HealthShield. I'm Aria. How can I help?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Uh... hello? Hello? Can you hear me?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Yes, I can hear you. How can I help you today?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Um. I was just... actually, I forget now. Let me think.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Take your time. I'm here to help when you're ready.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Yeah, yeah. Just... you know. The thing. About insurance.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Of course! Are you interested in a health insurance plan or do you have an existing policy question?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Maybe. I'm not sure. Could be either actually.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: That's okay. I can help with both. Could I ask your name to get started?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: It's... hmm. Actually you know what, never mind. I'll call back later. Goodbye.
